npc_blocks.title: Mama Mantis (Orchid Mantis, Spring) — Large Monstrosity (mantis), Unaligned
npc_blocks.stats: AC 16 (natural armor) | HP 152 (16d10+64) | Speed 30 ft., climb 30 ft. | STR 18 (+4) DEX 18 (+4) CON 18 (+4) INT 6 (-2) WIS 14 (+2) CHA 8 (-1)
npc_blocks.defenses: Saves: DEX +7, CON +7 | Resistances: nonmagical B/P/S while on/within 5 ft. of a flower (Floral Resilience) | Skills: Stealth +10, Perception +5, Athletics +7 | Senses: darkvision 60 ft., blindsight 10 ft., passive Perception 15 | CR 7 (2900 XP) | PB +3

entries.name: Floral Mimicry
entries.text:
While on a flower of Large size or larger, Mama can Hide as an action with advantage. While hidden she is INVISIBLE to creatures more than 5 ft. from the flower's center. Cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacker is on her flower; sight-targeted spells fail unless originator is on the flower.

FORCE VISIBLE: (a) move onto her flower AND succeed DC 16 Wisdom (Perception) as part of that movement; OR (b) make a melee attack against the flower at disadvantage — on a hit she is revealed and the camouflage ends.

Re-hiding requires the Hide action.

entries.name: Standing Leap
entries.text: Long jump up to 30 ft., high jump up to 15 ft., with or without a running start.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: Two Raptorial Scythe attacks, OR one Scythe + one Snap-Bite, OR (both scythes free + Pin-and-Hold recharged) one Pin-and-Hold attempt replacing both scythe attacks. While grappling a creature with Pin-and-Hold, Multiattack reduces to ONE Raptorial Scythe OR ONE Snap-Bite.

entries.name: Raptorial Scythe
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) slashing. On a crit: target also bleeds 4 (1d8) slashing at start of its next turn unless it or an ally uses an action to staunch (no check).

entries.name: Snap-Bite
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing. Crits on 18–20 if target is grappled by Mama.

entries.name: Pin-and-Hold (Recharge 5–6)
entries.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium-or-smaller target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) slashing + DC 15 STR save or GRAPPLED (escape DC 15) and RESTRAINED. Only one creature can be grappled this way at a time.

EVISCERATING SQUEEZE — At the start of Mama's turn, the grappled target takes:
  • Round 1 of grapple: 13 (2d8+4) piercing.
  • Round 2+ of grapple: 26 (4d10+4) piercing AND DC 15 CON save or STUNNED until start of its next turn (free 18–20 crit Snap-Bite next round).

GRAPPLE ENDS / INTERRUPT (any of):
  • Target makes escape check (action, DC 15 STR Athletics or DEX Acrobatics).
  • Adjacent ally uses an action: DC 15 STR (Athletics) to pry her loose.
  • Mama takes 30+ damage from a single source while grappling: CON save (DC = half damage taken, min 10) or release.
  • Mama knocked prone, blinded, frightened, stunned, paralyzed, or shoved more than 5 ft.

entries.name: Bound
entries.text: Leap to an adjacent flower within 30 ft.; no opportunity attacks. If using Floral Mimicry, camo ends — observers see the leap and know which flower she landed on, but not where on it (20-ft. square). At start of a creature's next turn it may make DC 14 WIS (Perception) to narrow her position to a 5-ft. quadrant.

entries.name: Reactive Scythe
entries.text: When a creature Mama can see moves within 10 ft. of her or attacks her while she is camouflaged on a flower, she may make one Raptorial Scythe attack against that creature. If using Floral Mimicry, the camouflage ends after the reaction resolves.

entries.name: Opening
entries.text: Hidden on the largest/brightest flower in the patch. Lets the party commit, then opens Pin-and-Hold on the most isolated melee target — preferring lightly-armored PCs she can eviscerate quickly.

entries.name: Mid-fight
entries.text: Bounds away the round after a successful kill or failed Squeeze, re-hiding on a fresh flower. Only abandons the grapple if she takes 30+ damage in one hit or if both oothecae come under direct threat.

entries.name: Reactive Scythe baiting
entries.text: Punishes the first ranged attacker who climbs her flower without thinking. Use the reaction the FIRST time a PC enters her flower; subsequent visitors should be punished by Pin-and-Hold instead.

entries.name: Frenzy clause (homebrew)
entries.text: If BOTH oothecae are destroyed: Mama gains advantage on Pin-and-Hold attack rolls for the rest of the encounter.

npc_blocks.title: Mantis Nymph (Orchid Mantis, Spring) — Small Monstrosity (mantis), Unaligned
npc_blocks.stats: AC 13 (natural armor) | HP 22 (4d6+8) | Speed 25 ft., climb 25 ft. | STR 12 (+1) DEX 16 (+3) CON 14 (+2) INT 4 (-3) WIS 12 (+1) CHA 6 (-2)
npc_blocks.defenses: Skills: Stealth +5 | Senses: darkvision 30 ft., passive Perception 11 | CR 1/2 (100 XP) | PB +2

entries.name: Petal-Crouch
entries.text: While on a flower of Medium size or larger, advantage on Stealth checks. NOT invisibility — players can target normally if they spot the nymph.

entries.name: Pack Striker
entries.text: Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one ally (Mama or another nymph) is within 5 ft. of the target and not incapacitated.

entries.name: Springing Leap
entries.text: Long jump up to 15 ft., high jump up to 10 ft., as part of movement.

entries.name: Nymph-Scythe
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+3) slashing.

entries.name: Behavior
entries.text: Hop toward whichever PC Mama has grappled, taking advantage from Pack Striker. If Mama is incapacitated, target the nearest bleeding or prone PC. They do not coordinate beyond instinct — all swarm the same target if given the chance.

entries.name: Morale (DM call)
entries.text: If Mama is killed: nymphs may flee, frenzy, or fight on per DM discretion.

npc_blocks.title: Mantis Ootheca (Orchid Mantis, Spring) — Small Object
npc_blocks.stats: AC 12 (foam shell) | HP 15 (flat) | Speed 0 ft. | All abilities 1 / 0 (treat as inanimate)
npc_blocks.defenses: Vulnerable: fire | Immune (damage): poison, psychic | Immune (conditions): blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, stunned, unconscious | CR 1/8 (25 XP) | PB +2

entries.name: Object
entries.text: Inanimate. Melee attacks against it hit automatically; ranged attacks have advantage. A creature can crush an ootheca as an action with a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check.

entries.name: Hatch Timer
entries.text: Hatches on initiative count 20 of ROUND 3 (three full rounds of grace). Each surviving ootheca produces one Mantis Nymph in its space; the new nymph rolls initiative and acts on its own count from the following round. A destroyed ootheca produces nothing.

entries.name: Pheromone Tether
entries.text: While at least one ootheca is intact, Mama will not flee the patch even below half HP. If all oothecae are destroyed AND she is below half HP, she may disengage and retreat (DM discretion).

entries.name: Quick destruction
entries.text: Fire damage doubles (vulnerability) — a single Fire Bolt or torch swing usually one-shots it. Any ranged attack hitting for 15+ destroys an ootheca outright. DC 12 Athletics as an action also works.

notes.label: Setup
notes.text: Beeatrix has sent the party into the flower patch to deal with the mantis preying on her field. Map on the whiteboard: 4–6 flowers (each treated as a 20-ft. square) at ~30 ft. spacing, connected by vines/plateaus. Mama hidden on the brightest flower at the start. Oothecae visible: one near Mama's starting flower, one on an adjacent flower. The party should be able to SEE the oothecae from the start of the encounter (a quick Survival or Nature ping makes them obvious if not).

notes.label: Difficulty note
notes.text: Opening XP budget: Mama 2900 + 2× Nymph 200 + 2× Ootheca 50 = 3150 XP. Three level-6 PCs Hard threshold ≈ 2250 XP; Deadly ≈ 3400. Sits between Hard and Deadly — appropriate for a planned headline boss with rescue mechanics. If both oothecae hatch (party ignored them), encounter inflates by 200 XP plus tempo cost. Should NOT TPK; should TERRIFY one PC at a time and force coordination.

notes.label: Recharge tracking
notes.text: Mama: Pin-and-Hold (5–6). Roll at start of each of her turns.

notes.label: Hatch Timer
notes.text: Oothecae hatch on initiative count 20 of ROUND 3 (three full rounds of grace). Each surviving ootheca produces 1 nymph; new nymphs roll initiative and act on their own count starting the following round. Mark each round-end on the whiteboard so the players feel the clock.

notes.label: The two-turn threat (math check)
notes.text: A level-6 PC with ~40 HP grappled and not rescued takes ~13 on Mama's round-1 squeeze, ~26 on round-2 squeeze = ~39 damage over two of Mama's turns. Round-2 CON save (DC 15) failure adds STUNNED for 1 round, which gives Mama a free auto-crit Snap-Bite next turn. SURVIVABLE with healing or rescue; LETHAL if ignored. Drix's Healing Word (bonus, 60 ft.) and Nancy's Shield reaction are the obvious rescue tools.

notes.label: Force-visible reminder
notes.text: While Mama is camouflaged on a flower, ranged attacks against her FAIL unless the attacker is on the flower. To engage at range, a PC must (a) move onto her flower AND DC 16 Wisdom (Perception) to pinpoint, OR (b) melee-attack the flower at disadvantage. Reactive Scythe punishes the first PC who climbs her flower.

notes.label: Floral Resilience (homebrew)
notes.text: Mama has resistance to nonmagical B/P/S while on or within 5 ft. of a flower. Tabby's longbow (mundane) is halved; magical weapons / spells / fire / cold / etc. are not. This is the leash that makes leaving the flower a real cost for her.

notes.label: Frenzy clause (homebrew)
notes.text: If BOTH oothecae are destroyed: Mama gains advantage on Pin-and-Hold attack rolls for the rest of the encounter. Stat-block rider — confirm at table.

notes.label: Pheromone Tether (homebrew, [SLOP] flagged)
notes.text: While ≥1 ootheca survives, Mama will not flee even below half HP. Pure flavor lever — ignore if you don't want it.

notes.label: Rewards (per s06 draft)
notes.text: Mantible — invisibility-capable short sword (1d8 finesse, kukri shape) salvaged from one of Mama's mandibles. Mantis-spine dagger (cosmetic flavor or DM-call). Bee gives a little gold; the real reward is from the mantis.

notes.label: Campaign cross-ref
notes.text: This is the planted payoff for the 'Mantises in the Overgrowth' thread foreshadowed in Sessions 4–5. Bee field side quest, Beeatrix as questgiver (offscreen in this fight per DM call). Located in the Overgrowth, magic-amplified zone.
